name: Pfundser Stüberl
kurzbeschreibung:
**Welcome to Pfundser Stüberl in Tirol!**

Nestled in the heart of the **Zillertal Alps**, this cozy mountain hut invites you to experience authentic Tyrolean hospitality. After a day of hiking, skiing, or exploring the stunning landscapes of **Tirol**, warm up with hearty dishes like **Kaiserschmarrn**, **Käsespätzle**, or a steaming bowl of **Tiroler Gröstl**.

Enjoy the rustic charm of our wooden interiors, where the crackling fireplace sets the perfect mood for a relaxing evening. Whether you're craving traditional **Tiroler Speckknödel** or a refreshing **Apfelstrudel**, our menu is crafted with local ingredients to delight your taste buds.

Just a short drive from **Innsbruck**, **Mayrhofen**, and **Zell am Ziller**, Pfundser Stüberl is your ideal retreat—where nature, culture, and culinary delights come together in perfect harmony. **Willkommen in Tirol!**
